caption: The drawing depicts a single, large eagle with its wings partially spread downward, occupying the center of the composition. The eagle is rendered in shades of tan, brown, and beige, with detailed feathers on both the wings and body. Both of the eagle’s talons are prominently visible, positioned as if gripping the top of a dark gray, trapezoidal plinth or base. Below the talons, a stylized acanthus leaf ornament in a gold or tan color curves outward along the bottom edge of the base. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or textures present. The composition is balanced, with the eagle and base forming the central and only focus of the image.
title: Spread Eagle Relief
